hint: The expected signature is built as "sha256=" + hex digest, but X-xPayment-Signature is the bare lowercase hex digest, so every real delivery is refused.
The HMAC is computed over json.dumps of the parsed body, not over the raw request bytes; any difference in whitespace or key order breaks the signature.
The signature is compared with !=, not with a constant-time comparison such as hmac.compare_digest.
POST /hooks/xpayment/refunds changes orders without checking the webhook signature at all.
WEBHOOK_SECRET falls back to a plain string written in the code when XPAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set.
The API key is written in the source as the default of XPAYMENT_API_KEY, so it ends up in git.
create_link sends no X-Idempotency-Key header, so a retry can create a second payment link for the same order.
The order status is read from body.get("status"), but the webhook body carries no status; the handler never does GET /v2/payments/{id} to learn it.
STATUS_TO_ORDER maps only COMPLETED; EXPIRED, CANCELLED, FAILED and refunds never change the order.
delivery_id is never stored, so a repeated delivery runs again (the receipt is sent every time).
get_payment calls /v2 with config.DEVICE_KEY, a cashbox key (xdev_) that only works on /v1; /v2 needs an xapi_ key.
create_link sends callback_url, a field that POST /v2/payments/link does not have in its OpenAPI schema.
